g.text: All accepted updates shown; darker lines are fixed 250-update medians (not confidence intervals).
Online loss uses pre-update parameters at step s−1; the log is written after accepted update s. EMA monitor uses post-update EMA at s.

g.text: Dotted lines: 10k full-state continuation; T also has a 201-step cold restore. C/T training examples differ, so minibatch loss is not a paired method score.
